tldr: Physical AI Agents extend Vertical AI Agents into the physical world by integrating cognitive reasoning (via specialized LLMs) with perception and actuation, proposed through a modular three-block architecture and the Physical Retrieval Augmented Generation (Ph-RAG) design pattern.
contributions: Proposes a modular architecture for Physical AI Agents with three core blocks: perception, cognition, and actuation
Introduces the Physical Retrieval Augmented Generation (Ph-RAG) design pattern connecting physical intelligence to industry-specific LLMs for real-time decision-making
Demonstrates applications across autonomous vehicles, warehouse robotics, healthcare, manufacturing, and agriculture through case studies
methods: The paper proposes a standardized modular architecture structured around perception, cognition, and actuation blocks, with Ph-RAG bridging physical context to domain-specific LLMs. Case studies are presented for five industries—autonomous vehicles, warehouse robotics, healthcare/surgical robotics, manufacturing, and agriculture—each detailing how sensors, LLM reasoning, cognitive skills, tools, and actuators integrate to perform physical tasks.
results: Case studies demonstrate Physical AI Agents transforming autonomous vehicles (LIDAR, cameras, radar, GPS guiding braking decisions), warehouse robotics (SLAM navigation, object recognition for picking/replenishing), healthcare (image segmentation and motion stabilization for surgical robots), manufacturing (vision models for defect detection and robotic welding), and agriculture (spectral imaging for crop health and autonomous irrigation). Industry platforms like NVIDIA Isaac, ROS, AWS RoboMaker, Google Robotics Core, NVIDIA Cosmos, and NVIDIA Edify SimReady are cited as foundational efforts.
limitations: No universally accepted architecture currently exists for Physical AI Agent design and implementation
Platform development for Physical AI Agents is described as being in its early stages
Cites prior work [2] extensively for deeper Vertical AI Agent frameworks rather than providing full implementation details here
References general limitations of general-purpose LLMs such as data limitations, vertical reasoning gaps, and ethical concerns
